label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: A regional popup (Looks like you are in the ES) covered the page on arrival; I had to find and close it before anything else, and the page behind it was still announced as readable content.

element.name: Looks like you are in the ES.

findings.problem: The home page lists dozens of products and carousels before any clear way to filter; many product cards have identical Add to Cart buttons and Subscribe Save toggles announced as already pressed, which is confusing about whether subscription is on by default.

element.name: Disable subscription and save option for Bar Soap 6-Pack

findings.problem: After Add to Cart the cart drawer said Calculating and Adding with the Checkout button disabled; I had to re-read to know when it was ready, and the add button changed to an unnamed-looking Cart icon.
After Proceed To Checkout the new page first showed an empty main region with no content and no loading message; I only learned the form had appeared by re-reading.

The checkout form has a Text Offers marketing signup and a second Remember me phone box mixed into the Payment group before the final Complete order button, which is easy to confuse with required fields.
